description: We are a team of ambitious students passionate about science, technology, engineering, and space exploration. We aim to solve real-world challenges through creativity, scientific thinking, and collaboration. We welcome motivated teammates with skills in programming, research, astronomy, biology, chemistry, engineering, data analysis, or design. Most importantly, we value curiosity, teamwork, commitment, and innovative thinking.
summary:
MARTIAN MAP is an interactive survival map for the first astronauts at Jezero Crater, Mars. It answers one question: from where I stand right now, what is my safest next move?

The map covers a 20 km radius around the Perseverance landing site, built from real NASA/USGS data: a 5 m orbital image mosaic, a 20 m elevation model, and the rover’s actual 45 km traverse, viewable in 2D and 3D. A habitat lands at a random safe spot, and the app plans the best route to three tasks only a human can do: growing plants in Martian soil, drilling lake mud to test a potential biosignature, and recovering a sample tube Perseverance left behind. Users can drop pins to reroute around red hazard zones such as steep slopes and sand traps.

A neural network trained on 90,000 simulated EVAs, calibrated with Apollo, MEDA, and RAD measurements, estimates the success of five options: continue, rest, return, shelter, or call rescue. Outcomes are simulated, not measured.
details: MARTIAN MAP is an interactive 2D/3D survival map of Jezero Crater for astronauts on foot or by rover. It covers a 20 km radius around the Perseverance landing site. A habitat lands at a random safe spot, and the app plans the best route to three science tasks, avoiding hazards. Users can drop pins to change the route, and it is recalculated instantly. At any point on the map, a neural network reads the terrain plus environment, body, and suit sensor values and estimates the success of five options: continue, rest, return, shelter, or call rescue. A RANDOM button creates emergencies such as dust storms, radiation events, or suit leaks.
